description: List work order schedules (technician day plans). Filter by technician_id + scheduled_date to get one technician's ordered day: rows are returned by date, then stop_order (the day-plan stop sequence; rows without stop_order sort last), then start time. travel_time_minutes is a straight-line estimate from the previous stop.

page.description: Page number (default: all pages fetched automatically)

per_page.description: Items per page (default: 1000, max: 1000). All pages are fetched automatically.

name: list_work_order_schedules
title: List work order schedules
